verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe this exact use case. Finance teams issue an instant virtual card per software subscription with per-vendor spending limits and no shared card numbers (ramp-docs-31). Funds can be restricted to allowed merchants, categories, amounts and intervals (ramp-docs-41), virtual cards are positioned for reusable subscription charges (ramp-supp-agent-cards), and they can be issued programmatically (ramp-supp-virtual-cards-vault). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of merchant-locking in practice, and explicit documentation tying per-vendor cards to the procurement workflow rather than only SaaS.
